title: First and Last Word · Pair relay
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play First and Last Word · Pair relay with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Choose two unrelated common words. The lead tells a short story beginning with the first word and ending with the second. The story uses both words in the specified positions and makes sense. Form pairs. On each pair’s turn, both people make separate attempts with fresh challenges, helping only their partner. The pair earns one point only if both succeed. Each pair has two turns. Highest score wins.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 4, 6 or 8 players; materials: Paper and pencil.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In First and Last Word, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The story uses both words in the specified positions and makes sense.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
recall.why: The story uses both words in the specified positions and makes sense.
